keeperSkills.purpose: Creates and maintains Figma Code Connect `.figma.ts` template files that map Figma components to code snippets, using the `figma.code` tagged-template pattern (never `.figma.tsx`/`figma.connect()`).
Mandatory prerequisite skill for creating a blank Figma file (design, FigJam, or Slides) via the `create_new_file` MCP tool, resolving plan keys and editor type first.

Mandatory prerequisite before calling `get_design_context`; governs how an agent turns a Figma design into implementation code (asset handling, hint priority hierarchy, adapting reference React/Tailwind output to the target stack).

Structured six-step workflow for translating an application page/view/multi-section layout into a Figma file built from a published design system (components, bound variables, styles) rather than hardcoded values.

Mandatory prerequisite before calling `generate_diagram`; routes to type-specific Mermaid guidance for flowcharts, sequence/state/ER diagrams and Gantt charts rendered into FigJam, and tells the agent when to skip the tool.

Five-phase (discovery, foundations, structure, components, integration/QA), non-one-shot workflow for building or updating a production-grade design system in Figma from a codebase, with a persistent state ledger for long-running runs.

Translates Figma motion/animation data (from `get_motion_context`, paired with `get_design_context`) into production animation code in the codebase's existing motion library, preserving transform origins and respecting `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Bidirectional SwiftUI <-> Figma translation skill: implementing a Figma design in SwiftUI, or pushing SwiftUI views/tokens back into a Figma file, including iOS semantic color and SF Symbol mapping.
FigJam-specific context and rules for agents calling the `use_figma` MCP tool inside a FigJam file, loaded alongside the base `figma-use` skill.
Motion/animation extension to `use_figma` covering manual keyframe tracks, animation styles, easing and timeline duration on Figma nodes, gated behind a `metronome` feature flag.
Slides-specific context and rules for agents calling `use_figma` to build or edit Figma Slides decks (design-thinking-first workflow, slide-grid quirks, append-before-position rule).

Foundational, mandatory-prerequisite skill for every `use_figma` MCP tool call: how to execute JavaScript against the Figma Plugin API correctly (data flow, page-context rules, common pitfalls, efficient batch APIs).
